question: Robert, Chris and Jeremy can finish a certain piece of work in 10, 14 and 21 days,respectively. All three of them started the work together. Robert left the work after 5 days and Chris left just 2 days before the work was completed. Find the total number of days taken for the work to be completed.
solution:
**Given:**

Robert = 10 days, Chris = 14 days, Jeremy = 21 days. All start together. Robert leaves after 5 days. Chris leaves 2 days before completion.

**Formula used:**

Work = sum(rate × time) ; rate = 1 / days.

**Calculations:**

Let Total work = 210 units

Efficiency of Robert = 210 ÷ 10 = 21 units/day, Chris = 210 ÷ 14 = 15 units/day, Jeremy = 210 ÷ 21 = 10 units/day

Let total time = T
